## 1. Resolution source

**(a) Time left:** about 30 days. The fight is on November 28, 2026, and the result will be known that night.

**(b) Status quo:** The fight goes ahead as scheduled and Kabayel, a 1/20 to -1800 favourite, wins, most likely by stoppage.

**(c) Base rates:**
- Kabayel has stopped his last 6 opponents. In order, they ended in R3, R6, R7, R4, R3 and R1.
- His elite-level stoppages cluster in rounds 3 to 7.
- Over his career, about 22% of his fights went to decision, but none since 2021.
- Generic rates for heavy favourites in heavyweight title fights: the favourite wins about 85-90% of the time, and a fight is cancelled or postponed inside the final month roughly 3-6% of the time.
- Hysa has knocked out nearly everyone early, but against weak opposition. He is 42 and his chin and stamina over long fights are untested.

**(d) Strongest evidence:**
- Betting odds (FanDuel, around Oct 2026) of Kabayel -1800 and Hysa +900 imply about 90% for Kabayel after margin.
- Boente predicted on Oct 13 that Kabayel wins within five rounds, by pressure and body work.
- As of Oct 28-29 there are no injury or postponement reports, and more than 40,000 tickets have been sold.
- Hysa's best wins were against Narmo and Korte, so this is a big step up in opposition.
- Kalshi prices Kabayel holding the WBC title on Jan 1, 2027 at about 0.82, which is consistent but noisy.

**(e) Unexpected scenario:** Hysa is a real one-punch counter-puncher. Boente himself warned about his right hand. He could catch Kabayel coming forward early and win by KO. Alternatively, the 42-year-old could pull out of camp injured, or the fight could be cut short by a cut. Any of these would resolve as "Other outcome".

**Reasoning:** I start from about 89% for a Kabayel win before cancellation risk, then take about 3% off for cancellation, giving about 87% for a Kabayel win. Against an older, less experienced challenger, the stoppage is likely to come somewhat earlier than in Kabayel's elite fights. Kabayel's body-attack style tends to break opponents in rounds 3 to 6. A decision remains possible if Hysa is durable and survives in survival mode. "Other outcome" covers a Hysa win (about 8%), cancellation (about 3%) and a draw or no contest (about 1%), for a total of about 13%.

(b) **Status quo:** The fight is confirmed, with over 40,000 tickets sold and no reports of injury or postponement. Kabayel, the WBC champion at 27-0 with 19 KOs, is a heavy favourite. His last six fights all ended inside the distance, so the status quo outcome is a Kabayel stoppage.

(c) **Base rates:**
- Kabayel's stoppages by round: 13 in rounds 1-3, 4 in rounds 4-6 and 2 in rounds 7-12.
- He has won 6 of 27 fights by decision, all in 2021 or earlier.
- Against elite opponents since 2023 he stopped Makhmudov in R4, Sánchez in R7, Zhang in R6 and Knyba in R3. Better opponents tend to push his stoppages into the middle rounds.
- Big betting favourites around -1800 win about 90-93% of the time.
- Late cancellations of confirmed stadium-level fights happen roughly 3-5% of the time in the final month, especially with a 42-year-old challenger.

(d) **Strongest evidence:**
- FanDuel has Kabayel at -1800 and Hysa at +900, which implies about 90%+ for Kabayel after removing the margin.
- The fight was confirmed in early October 2026.
- Promoter Bernd Boente (Oct 13) predicts Kabayel wins "within five rounds" through early pressure.
- Boxing247 (Oct 6) notes Hysa is ranked 18th by the WBC and has never beaten an established contender.
- Hysa (25-0, 23 KOs) stopped Narmo in R2 on Aug 29, but his record has been built against weak opposition and he has never gone deep into a fight.
- The Kalshi WBC title market has Kabayel at about 0.82, but it is illiquid.

(e) **Unexpected outcome scenario:** Hysa lands his counter right hand early while Kabayel is walking forward and pressing, and scores an upset KO. Alternatively, Hysa withdraws through injury in camp at age 42, the fight is cancelled or a substitute replaces him, and the question resolves as "Other."

**Reasoning:**
- I start from roughly 90% Kabayel win and 10% for "Other", which covers a Hysa win, a draw or no fight. I raise "Other" slightly to 12% to allow for cancellation risk.
